errors.text_span: the structural effect of the forest
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states 'structural effect of the forest,' whereas the figure shows 'structural effect on average bed-days (%)' as the label for Figure B.
The description does not explain the purpose of Figure A, which illustrates the change in average bed-days over the years.
The description does not explain the purpose of Figure B, which illustrates the structural effect on average bed-days as a percentage change over the years.
The description does not mention the x-axis label 'Години' (Years) or its intervals (2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, 2021) for either figure.
The description does not mention the y-axis label 'Средни леглодни (дни)' (Average bed-days (days)) or its range (200 to 280 days) for Figure A.
The description does not mention the y-axis label 'Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)' (Structural effect on average bed-days (%)) or its range (0% to over 2%) for Figure B.
The description does not mention the red lines and black markers used to represent data points in both figures.
The description does not mention the trends in Figure A, such as the initial decrease, slight increase in 2013, and significant drop by 2021.
The description does not mention the trends in Figure B, such as the sharp drop to 0.3% in 2013 and the subsequent rise to nearly 2.8% in 2021.
The description omits the year 2013, which is clearly labeled and represented in both figures.
